title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science or related STEM field
qualification: Proficiency in C++, C#, Java, or Python and strong data structures knowledge
description: As a Software Engineering Intern at Microsoft, you will work on high-impact projects, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and write code used by millions of users globally.

title: Chevening Master's Scholarship
eligibility: Citizens of Chevening-eligible countries with at least 2 years of work experience
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition fees, monthly living stipend, return flights)
qualification: Undergraduate degree that enables entry into a postgraduate programme at a UK university
description: Chevening Scholarships enable outstanding emerging leaders from all over the world to pursue a one-year master’s degree in any subject at any UK university.

title: Junior Data Analyst
eligibility: Open to early-career data professionals worldwide
qualification: Proficiency in SQL, Python or R, and experience with data visualization tools like Tableau or Looker
description: Join GitLab's fully remote team to build operational dashboards, analyze user behavior data, and support data-driven strategic decisions across engineering and product teams.

title: Associate Product Manager
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with 0-2 years of full-time experience
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
description: The APM program is a premier two-year rotational opportunity designed to develop technical product leaders through hands-on experience guiding Google products from vision to launch.

title: CS50's Introduction to Artificial Intelligence with Python
eligibility: Open to students and self-learners globally
description: Explore the concepts and algorithms at the foundation of modern artificial intelligence, diving into graph search algorithms, classification, optimization, and machine learning principles.

title: Imagine Cup Global Student Tech Competition
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school, college, or university
salary: $100,000 USD grand prize + Azure credits and mentorship
qualification: Working software prototype addressing a real-world problem built using Microsoft Azure
description: The Imagine Cup is Microsoft's global student developer competition providing participants the opportunity to create innovative AI and cloud solutions that drive positive change.
